Review the current regulatory framework for Reinsurance and make suitable recommendations. 2. Study international regulatory framework and practices relating to Reinsurance Pools , Alternative Risk Transfer (ART) and such other mechanisms and make appropriate recommendations for India. 3. Study the existing guidelines for SEZ and make necessary recommendations in the context of various Reinsurance activities. 4. Make specific recommendations and devise formats for reports and returns - required to be submitted to I ROAi. The Committee may meet at its convenience and as often as necessary to carry out its deliberations. chunks.heading: **II. Terms of Reference of the Committee:**
chunks.content:
1. Review the current regulatory framework for Reinsurance and make suitable recommendations. 

2. Study international regulatory framework and practices relating to Reinsurance Pools , Alternative Risk Transfer (ART) and such other mechanisms and make appropriate recommendations for India. 

3. Study the existing guidelines for SEZ and make necessary recommendations in the context of various Reinsurance activities. 

4. Make specific recommendations and devise formats for reports and returns 

   - required to be submitted to I ROAi. 

The Committee would be expected to interact with all relevant stakeholders - Cedants , Reinsurers, Retrocessionaires, Brokers , Customers etc. before arriving at its recommendations . It may form sub-committees if required , to work on and deliver on the ToR.

chunks.heading: **Ill. Submission of Report and Recommendations:**
chunks.content:
The Committee shall finalize and submit its report to the undersigned on or before 31<sup>st</sup> August , 2017. The Committee may meet at its convenience and as often as necessary to carry out its deliberations. Travelling allowances and sitting fees will be payable to the Chairman and Members as per the rules of the Authority.
